parsed.explanation: 1) Added missing closing </BIBL> tag - the 3rd <BIBL> (Stettlers...) was never closed before </ITEM>, making XML not well-formed. 2) Split semantically incorrect grouping: <TITLE>Reich der Todten</TITLE> was nested inside the Stettlers BIBL but is a separate work, so created a separate <BIBL><TITLE>Reich der Todten</TITLE></BIBL>. 3) Moved trailing non-bibliographic prose ('samt noch einigen anderen neuen... in Commission hat.') outside of BIBL - it describes the catalog/sale, not a bibliographic entry (optionally could be wrapped in <NOTE>). 4) Fixed 3 mojibake/encoding errors: frantz\u221a\u2202sisch -> französisch, B\u221a\u00bcheren/B\u221a\u00bcher -> Bücheren/Bücher, Commi- \u221a\u00fcion -> Commission. 5) Normalized typography: 'Schweitzer- Chronick' -> 'Schweitzer-Chronick' (removed erroneous space after hyphen).
